title: Lixity — quantitative text linguistics and stylometry for literary manuscripts
description: Lixity analyses literary manuscripts locally and deterministically: sentence rhythm, lexical diversity (HD-D, MTLD, MATTR, Maas, Yule's K), language-calibrated readability, dialogue share, paragraph-level tense profiles and a self-calibrating style reference with robust median/MAD bands, noise-adjusted deviations, Benjamini-Hochberg/Benjamini-Yekutieli selections and effect sizes. It runs offline without a cloud service and is implemented in pure Python. Statistical signals support human review; they are not literary-quality scores.
notes: Deposited from a tagged GitHub release of the software.
